αἴδεο: αἰδέομαι — respect, show regard for; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic αἰδοῦ): ’show respect to’
βαθυδινήεντος: βαθυδινήεις — deep-eddying; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ξάνθου
βαθύρροον: βαθύρροος — deep-flowing; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic βαθύρρουν), agreeing with ποταμόν

γεύσεται: γεύω — give a taste of; mid. taste, partake of (+ gen.); fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’he shall taste’

γυμνὸν: γυμνός — bare, unarmed, naked; masc. acc. sg., predicate of the object: ’naked’

δίνας: δίνη — eddy, whirlpool; fem. acc. pl., after περί: ’round the eddies’

διατμήξας: διατμήγω — cut apart, split; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having cut in two’
δυωδεκάτῃ: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. dat. sg., dat. of time, with ἡμέρᾳ understood: ’on the twelfth (day)’
εἰλεῦντο: εἰλέω — press together, crowd, drive; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic -εῦντο (= Attic εἰλοῦντο): ’were crowded’
εἰμ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic, elided (εἰμ’ = εἰμι): ’I am’
εἷλες: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. 2 sg. act., augmented (ἑ- + ἐλ- > εἷλ-): ’you took’
εὐόρμου: εὔορμος — with good anchorage; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with λιμένος
ζόφου: ζόφος — gloom, darkness (of the world below); masc. gen. sg., after ὑπό: ’from beneath the gloom’
κεκλιμένον: κλίνω — lean, make slope; perf. part. mid./pass. neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’leaning’
κελάδων: κελαδέω — resound, roar; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic with the accent of a barytone verb (the contracted Attic participle is κελαδῶν): ’roaring’
κρημνούς: κρημνός — overhanging bank, steep bank; masc. acc. pl., after ὑπό of place: ’under the banks’
λάβῃσιν: λαμβάνω — take, seize, catch; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic λάβῃ), in a general clause with κε: ’catches’
λέξατο: λέγω — pick out, choose; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλέξατο): ’picked out for himself’
λαοθόη: Λαοθόη — Laothoe, daughter of Altes and mother of Lycaon; fem. nom. sg.
λελέγεσσι: Λέλεγες — the Leleges, a people of the Troad; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -εσι), after ἀνάσσει
λύμην: λύω — loose; ransom; aor. 1 sg. mid., athematic and unaugmented, passive in sense (epic = Attic ἐλύθην): ’I was ransomed’
μεγακήτεος: μεγακήτης — huge (probably μέγα- + κῆτος ’sea-monster’, but the formation is not certain); masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
μινυνθάδιον: μινυνθάδιος — short-lived, lasting but a little; masc. acc. sg., predicate of με: ’short-lived’
μυρίκῃσιν: μυρίκη — tamarisk; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), after κεκλιμένον: ’against the tamarisks’
μυχοὺς: μυχός — innermost part, nook, recess; masc. acc. pl., object of πιμπλᾶσι
νέους: νέος — young, new; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ὄρπηκας
νεβρούς: νεβρός — fawn; masc. acc. pl., after ἠΰτε: ’like fawns’
οὐτάμεναι: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic οὐτάσαι), of purpose after μεμαώς: ’to wound’
πέμψειν: πέμπω — send; fut. inf. act., after ἔμελλε: ’to send’
πίτνα: πίτνημι (= Attic πετάννυμι) — spread out; impf. 3 sg. act., epic, unaugmented: ’spread out’
παθών: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
πασάμην: πατέομαι — eat, taste; aor. 1 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἐπασάμην): ’I ate’
πατάγῳ: πάταγος — crash, clatter; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a crash’
πεπερημένος: περάω — carry across; sell (abroad); perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’having been sold’
πεφυζότες: φύζω (φύζα ’panic flight’) — flee in terror; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic: ’in headlong flight’
πιμπλᾶσι: πίμπλημι — fill; pres. 3 pl. act., athematic -ᾶσι, + acc.: ’they fill’
πορών: πορεῖν (aor. ἔπορον) — give, grant, furnish; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having paid’
προμολών: προβλώσκω — go forth, come forward; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (stem μολ-): ’coming forth’
προτέρῳ: πρότερος — earlier, former; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’the day before’
πρυλέεσσι: πρύλις — foot-soldier of the front rank; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -εσι), after μετά: ’among the foot-soldiers’
πτώσσουσι: πτώσσω — cower, crouch in fear; pres. 3 pl. act.
πτῶσσον: πτώσσω — cower, crouch in fear; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔπτωσσον): ’cowered’
σατνιόεντι: Σατνιόεις — the Satnioeis, a river of the Troad; masc. dat. sg., after ἐπί: ’on the Satnioeis’
στρεπτοῖσι: στρεπτός — twisted, pliant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with χιτῶσι
συνήντετο: συναντάω — meet, encounter (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic, augmented (ε+α > η): ’he met’
σὰς: σός — your (sg.); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
τεθηπότας: τέθηπα (perf. of ταφεῖν) — be astounded, stand stunned; perf. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’stunned’
τεθηπὼς: τέθηπα (perf. of ταφεῖν) — be astounded, stand stunned; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’stunned’
τεῇς: τεός — your (= σός); fem. dat. pl., epic τεῇς (= Attic σαῖς), agreeing with χερσίν
φλέγει: φλέγω — burn, blaze; pres. 3 sg. act.
φυγὼν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having escaped’
χιτῶσι: χιτών — tunic; masc. dat. pl., after ἐπί: ’over the tunics’
ἀκωκῆς: ἀκωκή — point, tip; fem. gen. sg., partitive object of γεύω: ’of the tip’
ἀναστήσονται: ἀνίστημι — set up; mid. rise up; fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’they will rise again’
ἀνώϊστον: ἀνώϊστος — unforeseen, unexpected (ἀ- + οἴομαι); neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’unforeseen’
ἀπεχθέσθαι: ἀπεχθάνομαι — be hateful to, be hated by (+ dat.); aor. inf. mid., after μέλλω: ’to be hateful to’
ἀργυροδίνην: ἀργυροδίνης — silver-eddying; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ποταμόν
ἄλλας: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. pl., substantive after πολλάς: ’others’
ἄλταο: Ἄλτης — Altes, king of the Leleges; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), with γέροντος
ἄλτεω: Ἄλτης — Altes, king of the Leleges; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), repeated in apposition
ἄμεναι: ἄω — satiate, glut; aor. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἆσαι), + gen.: ’to glut itself on’
ἅψασθαι: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of (+ gen.); aor. inf. mid., of purpose after μεμαώς: ’to touch’
ἐκφυγέειν: ἐκφεύγω — flee from, escape; aor. inf. act., epic -έειν (= Attic ἐκφυγεῖν), + acc.: ’to escape’
ἐλέησον: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy on; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’take pity on’
ἐλλίσσετο: λίσσομαι — entreat, beg; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic doubled λ (= ἐλίσσετο): ’entreated’
ἐναίρων: ἐναίρω — slay, kill; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’slaying’
ἐννύχιος: ἐννύχιος — in the night, by night; masc. nom. sg., predicate with the subject: ’by night’
ἐξῆγε: ἐξάγω — lead out; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented (ἐξ- + ἦγε): ’led out’
ἐπέρασσας: περάω — carry across; sell (abroad); aor. 2 sg. act., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἐπέρασας): ’you sold’
ἐπέρασσε: περάω — carry across; sell (abroad); aor. 3 sg. act., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἐπέρασε): ’sold’
ἐτέρπετο: τέρπομαι — take delight, enjoy oneself; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’delighted’
ἑκατόμβοιον: ἑκατόμβοιος — worth a hundred oxen; neut. acc. sg., as a noun, object of ἦλφον: ’the worth of a hundred oxen’
ἑλισσόμενοι: ἑλίσσω — turn, wheel; mid. turn oneself about; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’turning’
ἔννεον: νέω — swim; impf. 3 pl. act., epic doubled ν (= Attic ἔνεον): ’they swam’
ἔπεφνον: θείνω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — strike, slay; reduplicated aor. 1 sg. act., unaugmented: ’I killed’
ἕκτορός: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. gen. sg., with the extra accent of a following enclitic: ’of Hector’
ἠγαθέην: ἠγάθεος — very holy, sacred; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην, agreeing with Λῆμνον
ἠερόεντος: ἠερόεις — misty, murky; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ζόφου
ἡμίσεες: ἥμισυς — half; masc. nom. pl., epic -εες (= Attic ἥμισεις), as a noun: ’half (of them)’
ἦλφον: ἀλφάνω — fetch, bring in, earn; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented: ’I fetched, I brought in’
ἰήσονος: Ἰήσων — Jason (Attic Ἰάσων); masc. gen. sg., Ionic form, with υἱός: ’son of Jason’
ἱκέταο: ἱκέτης — suppliant; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), after ἀντί: ’as a suppliant’
ἴμβριος: Ἴμβριος — of Imbros, Imbrian; masc. nom. sg., in apposition with Ἠετίων
ὀλοή: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with μοῖρα: ’deadly’
ὁμογάστριος: ὁμογάστριος — born of the same womb; masc. nom. sg., predicate, + gen. of the other: ’from the same womb as’
ὄρπηκας: ὄρπηξ — shoot, sapling; masc. acc. pl., object of τάμνε
ὄχθῃ: ὄχθη — bank; fem. dat. sg., after ἐπί: ’on the bank’
ὑπέδραμε: ὑποτρέχω — run under, run beneath; aor. 3 sg. act. (stem δραμ-), augmented: ’ran in under’
ὦνον: ὦνος — price, purchase price; masc. acc. sg., object of ἔδωκε: ’the price’

__broaden__.γούνατ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα); ’loosen the knees’ means ’kill, unstring’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb of motion: ’(my) knees’ (γούνατα ὀρώρῃ) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’(the) knees are hampered’ (γούνατα βλάβεται) · also neut. acc. pl., object of ἐδάμνα in tmesis with ὑπό: ’(weariness) overcame the knees’ (ὑπὸ γούνατ’ ἐδάμνα)
__broaden__.εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may (they) be’ (αἲ γὰρ … μοι … εἶεν ’would that I had …’) · in a remote condition: ’if there were’ · also pres. opt. 3 pl. in a purpose clause after ἵνα in secondary sequence: ’might be’ (ἵν’ ἅρματος ἄντυγες εἶεν ’to be rails for a chariot’)
__broaden__.ζωοὺς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ζῶντας), predicate with νῶϊ: ’alive’ · also masc. acc. pl., predicate of the object κούρους: ’alive’ (ζωοὺς … κούρους ’youths alive’)
__broaden__.κάμε: κάμνω — toil, labour, grow weary; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε): ’toiled’ (κάμε τεύχων ’toiled at making’) · also with a direct object: ’made, wrought’ (πάνθ’ ὅπλα κάμε ’made all the arms’) · also with an acc. of respect: ’grew weary in’ (κάμε χεῖρας ’tired his hands’)
__broaden__.λῆμνον: Λῆμνος — Lemnos, the island; fem. acc. sg., object of εἰσαφίκανε · also fem. acc. sg., goal of motion after ἐπέρασσε (Λῆμνον … ἐπέρασσε ’sold him to Lemnos’) · also fem. acc. sg., goal after ἐς (Λῆμνον ἐς ἠγαθέην ’to holy Lemnos’)
__broaden__.φεύξεσθαι: φεύγω — flee, escape; fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ἔφαν: ’that they would flee’ · also fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ὀΐω, + acc.: ’that I shall escape’ (σὰς χεῖρας φεύξεσθαι ’to escape your hands’)
__broaden__.ἐρινεὸν: ἐρινεός — wild fig-tree; masc. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the wild fig tree’ · also masc. acc. sg., the tree cut from, object of τάμνε beside a second acc.: ’the wild fig-tree’ (ἐρινεὸν … τάμνε νέους ὄρπηκας ’cut young shoots from the fig-tree’)
__broaden__.ἐλύσατο: λύω — loose, unfasten; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’unfastened (for herself)’ · also ’ransomed, freed for a price’ (ξεῖνός μιν ἐλύσατο ’a guest-friend ransomed him’)
__broaden__.ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ · also impf. 3 sg., ’had as wife, was married to’ (θυγατέρα ἔχε ’had the daughter to wife’)
__broaden__.ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’ · also ’holding, possessing’, of a lord and his land (Πήδασον ἔχων ’holding Pedasus’)
__broaden__.ἔσχε: ἔχω — have, hold, hold up; aor. 3 sg.: ’held’ · also ’held back, checked’ (οὐδέ μιν ἔσχε ’did not hold him back’)
__broaden__.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’)
__broaden__.ἄνευθεν: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’away from’ (ἄνευθεν … πατρός τε φίλων τε ’away from my father and my dear ones’)
__broaden__.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’) · also adv. in tmesis after its verb, with an acc.: ’escaping’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ = ὑποφυγών, ’escaping the pitiless day’)
__broaden__.κτεῖν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (κτεῖν’ = κτεῖνε = Attic ἔκτεινε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (κτεῖν’ = κτεῖνε), with μή: ’do not kill’ (μή με κτεῖν’ ’do not kill me’)
__broaden__.ἔπεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), augmented (unaugmented πέσον); with σύν in tmesis, σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also with ἐν in tmesis, ἐν … ἔπεσον = ἐνέπεσον ’fell in’ (ἐν δ’ ἔπεσον ’and they fell in’)
